plainTranslation: The Moon person's feelings meet the Sun person's identity with very little translation needed. The Moon person often feels recognized at an instinctive level, while the Sun person feels emotionally received. Strong glue, but still not proof of fit; build behavior around the ease.
policy: Governed by synastry-policy. Descriptive, not deterministic; intensity is never treated as obligation, safety concerns override astrology.

summaryShort: Their moods, needs, and habits of comfort sit right on top of your sense of self, confidence, and direction.
summaryDeep: Their moods, needs, and habits of comfort sit right on top of your sense of self, confidence, and direction. This is one of the closest contacts between you, strong and constant, energizing at its best and a lot to hold at its worst. Let the closeness feed you without letting it run you.
tension: The problem is that comfort can turn into dependence. One person may start expecting the other to always be their soft place to land, and the relationship can get a little too comfortable without anyone noticing.
advice: Enjoy the closeness, but don't disappear into it. This works best when both people still have their own life.
